A Visit to the Science Museum: 和爷爷去科学博物馆:会下棋的机器人、可以走进的太空舱、屋顶望远镜看太阳黑子。

On Sunday morning, my grandfather took me to the science museum in the city centre. He worked as an engineer for thirty years, so he knows almost every machine in the building. "Ask me anything," he said with a smile.

My favourite part was the robot show. A small robot played chess with visitors and never lost a game. In the space area, we walked into a model of a space capsule and tried on heavy astronaut suits. Grandpa explained how rockets leave the earth, and a group of kids followed us just to listen to him.

Before leaving, we looked at the sun through a special telescope on the roof. I saw small dark spots moving slowly on it. "Those are sunspots," Grandpa said. On the bus home, I decided to study science hard, because I want to build things that make people say "wow", just like my grandfather's stories.
